statement: ThermalMultiphaseOpenLB implements the Peng-Robinson equation of state with acentric factor support, enabling thermodynamically consistent pseudopotential multiphase simulations at high density ratios.
notes: TensorLBM 可服务改进点: 可参考 Peng-Robinson EoS 实现为 TensorLBM 建立非理想状态方程模块，支持相变模拟中的热力学一致性密度计算。

statement: ThermalMultiphaseOpenLB implements the Carnahan-Starling equation of state as an alternative to Peng-Robinson, providing different thermodynamic behavior for pseudopotential multiphase flows.
notes: TensorLBM 可服务改进点: Carnahan-Starling EoS 适用于硬球流体，可为 TensorLBM 提供另一种状态方程选项。

statement: ThermalMultiphaseOpenLB implements a modified Guo forcing scheme (ForcedModifiedGuoBGKdynamics) based on Li, Luo & Li (Phys. Rev. E 86, 016709, 2012), with a correction factor sigma for thermodynamically consistent densities in pseudopotential LBM.
notes: TensorLBM 可服务改进点: 修正的 Guo 力格式可提升 TensorLBM 在多相流中的热力学一致性，消除虚假速度。

statement: ThermalMultiphaseOpenLB implements a semi-hybrid thermal solver using Double Distribution Function (DDF) approach, solving the thermal equation with explicit Euler to help set thermal diffusivity independently.

statement: ThermalMultiphaseOpenLB incorporates latent heat effects via the equation of state, using the temperature derivative of pressure (dP/dT) integrated over density to compute latent heat following Gong & Cheng (IJHMT 55, 4923-4927, 2012).
